about: Words the engines keep swapping in Medi's Arabic (Medi 2026-10-05: 'you are having a really hard time with 3ala and ala and allah. How can we address this. Can we cue gemini for similar sounding words?'). Hand-kept. Every re-hear / second-listen prompt (TR-22, scripts/bench_rehear.py template) and the Arabizi reader should carry this list as a cue: when the engine wrote one of a group, listen for the others and pick by meaning in the sentence. Add a group when a new swap shows up on the Lessons page ('Recording engine wrote ... fixed').

words.english: to (MSA; Medi rarely means it - usually 3ala or la-)
God (in a set phrase: inshallah, wallah, el-7amdellah)

groups.cue: Medi says 3ala for 'on/at' far more than ila; 'allah' only inside inshallah / wallah / 7amdellah. Decide by the noun after it.
after 3ala + a time word it is the hour (el-3ashrah); after 'akal / 3azam' it is dinner (el-3asha).
Medi reaches for 'motivated' and says shuja3 (brave); Amal recasts mitshajje3.
with met2a55ar / el-subu7 it is 'woke up'.
